_doc: Known audit defects accepted EXPLICITLY, with a date and a clearing condition. schema-audit.mjs (bundle mode only — never --file, so a fresh parse is always judged in full) moves a matching defect out of the headline count into 'accepted exceptions'. An exception that no longer matches a defect is itself reported as a defect, so it is deleted rather than left to rot.

exceptions.reason: Pre-gate parse: the first sample step (pipette_mix; step 1 is a side prepare) names no vessel.
exceptions.effect: None visible: the player defaults an unnamed first vessel to a microtube, which is what this step uses.
exceptions.clears_when: PCR is next re-parsed through the gate (scripts/reparse_examples.py pcr -> scripts/audited_parse.py).
